body.zh-Hant: 道格拉斯·海德生於1860年1月17日，卒於1949年7月12日。德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔把他列為文學史家，並記錄他的別名An Craoibhin Aoibhinn。
body.en: Douglas Hyde was born on 17 January 1860 and died on 12 July 1949. The German National Library authority file lists him as a literary historian and records the alias An Craoibhin Aoibhinn.

citations.quote: Literarhistoriker
An Craoibhin Aoibhinn

body.zh-Hant: 權威檔記載，他自1891年起在加拿大新不倫瑞克大學任現代語言教授，兩年後返回愛爾蘭。1893年他創立蓋爾聯盟，以復興與保存愛爾蘭語為宗旨，並擔任會長至1915年。1909至1932年，他在都柏林大學學院任現代愛爾蘭語教授。
body.en: The authority file records that from 1891 he was professor of modern languages at the University of New Brunswick in Canada and returned to Ireland two years later. In 1893 he founded the Gaelic League to revive and foster the Irish language and served as its president until 1915. From 1909 to 1932 he was professor of Modern Irish at University College Dublin.

body.zh-Hant: 愛爾蘭議會資料庫記載，海德於1925年2月4日至12月5日在1922年組成的參議院任議員，黨派欄為獨立人士。1938年4月27日至7月22日，他以總理提名名額進入第二屆參議院，同樣列為獨立人士。德國權威檔記載，他自1938年至1945年任愛爾蘭首任總統。
body.en: The Houses of the Oireachtas member data show Hyde in the 1922 Seanad from 4 February to 5 December 1925, listed as Independent. From 27 April to 22 July 1938 he sat in the 2nd Seanad on the Taoiseach's nominated panel, also as Independent. The German authority file says he was the first President of Ireland from 1938 to 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 里奧斯1888年11月10日生於智利阿勞科省卡涅特的韋奇庫拉農莊，父親是農民安塞爾莫·里奧斯·加列戈斯，母親是盧辛達·莫拉萊斯·莫拉萊斯。他完成康塞普西翁的官辦法學課程，時間是1914年，之後取得律師資格。
body.en: Ríos was born on 10 November 1888 at the Huichicura estate in Cañete, Arauco province. His father was the farmer Anselmo Ríos Gallegos and his mother Lucinda Morales Morales. He completed the state law course in Concepción in 1914 and later qualified as a lawyer.

citations.quote: Nació el 10 de noviembre de 1888 en el Fundo Huichicura
Su padre fue el agricultor Anselmo Ríos Gallegos
y su madre Lucinda Morales Morales
Curso Fiscal de Leyes de Concepción, el que concluyó en 1914
Posteriormente se título de abogado

heading.zh-Hant: 激進黨政治、駐巴拿馬與眾議員
heading.en: Radical Party politics, Panama and the Chamber

body.zh-Hant: 他年輕時加入激進青年團，後來進入激進黨中央委員會，代表阿勞科省。1920年他參與阿萊散德里的總統競選，1921年參選勞塔羅選區眾議員但落選。阿萊散德里政府任內，他任駐巴拿馬代辦兼總領事，任到1923年；1924年返國當選眾議員，但國會於同年9月11日被解散。
body.en: As a young man he joined the Radical Youth and later sat on the Radical Party's central board for Arauco province. In 1920 he took part in Alessandri's presidential campaign, and in 1921 he stood unsuccessfully for deputy for Lautaro. Under Alessandri he was chargé d'affaires and consul general in Panama until 1923; he returned in 1924, was elected deputy, and Congress was dissolved on 11 September 1924.

integró la Junta Central Radical, en representación de la Provincia de Arauco
En 1920, participó en la campaña presidencial de Arturo Alessandri Palma
En 1921, se presentó como candidato a diputado por Lautaro
pero no resultó electo

heading.zh-Hant: 憲法諮詢委員會與國會

body.zh-Hant: 1925年他是憲法改革諮詢委員會53名成員之一，委員會工作於8月30日結束。他在1925年再次當選眾議員，任期1926至1930年；後來當選阿勞科、馬耶科與考廷省的參議員，任期1930至1938年，但1932年6月6日國會被解散，任期中斷。
body.en: In 1925 he was one of the 53 members of the Consultative Commission for constitutional reform, whose work ended on 30 August. Re-elected deputy in 1925 for 1926-1930, he was then elected senator for Arauco, Malleco and Cautín for 1930-1938, but Congress was dissolved on 6 June 1932 and his term was cut short.

citations.quote: En 1925, fue designado entre los 53 integrantes de la Comisión Consultiva
Su labor terminó el 30 de agosto de ese mismo año
En 1925 fue reelecto diputado por la misma Circunscripción Departamental
electo senador por la Octava Agrupación Provincial de Arauco, Malleco y Cautín
el día 06 decretó la disolución del Congreso
Término de periodo: 6 de junio de 1932

heading.zh-Hant: 被逐出激進黨與1932年內閣

body.zh-Hant: 1931年卡洛斯·伊瓦涅斯政府垮台後，激進黨質疑他與該政府的合作，他以微小票差被開除黨籍。1932年他參與推翻蒙特羅總統的軍事政變，並於6月16日出任內政部長，9月14日至10月2日任司法部長。1933年他當選眾議員，同年重新被接納回黨。
body.en: In 1931, after Carlos Ibáñez fell, the Radical Party questioned his collaboration with that government and expelled him by a narrow vote. In 1932 he took part in the coup that overthrew President Montero, became interior minister from 16 June, and was justice minister from 14 September to 2 October. He was elected deputy in 1933 and readmitted to the party the same year.

body.zh-Hant: 1936年他參與組成人民陣線，聯盟包含激進黨、共產黨、社會黨等。他被提名為總統預備候選人，後讓位給阿吉雷·塞爾達，後者於1938年12月勝選。阿吉雷·塞爾達任內，他主持抵押信貸銀行。1941年11月25日阿吉雷·塞爾達去世。
body.en: In 1936 he took part in forming the Popular Front, an alliance of the Radical, Communist, Socialist and other parties. He was named presidential pre-candidate but stood aside for Pedro Aguirre Cerda, who won in December 1938. During Aguirre Cerda's presidency he headed the Caja de Crédito Hipotecario. Aguirre Cerda died on 25 November 1941.

body.zh-Hant: 里奧斯自1942年4月2日任總統，到1946年6月27日去世。任內審計長署取得憲法地位，國家電力、國家石油與太平洋鋼鐵公司等國營企業獲推動。他在二戰中謀求中立，1945年迫於美國壓力與德、義、日斷交。1946年1月17日起內政部長阿爾弗雷多·杜阿爾德接任副總統職務。
body.en: Ríos served as President from 2 April 1942 until his death on 27 June 1946. During his term the Comptroller General gained constitutional rank and state firms such as Endesa, ENAP and CAP were promoted. He sought neutrality in the Second World War but, under US pressure, broke relations with Germany, Italy and Japan in 1945. From 17 January 1946 Interior Minister Alfredo Duhalde took over as vice-president.

people.name: Johan Ludwig Mowinckel
people.nameZh: 約翰·路德維希·莫溫克爾

body.zh-Hant: 莫溫克爾1870年10月22日生於卑爾根，出身當地商人世家。他在1898年買下第一艘船，1901年在卑爾根自設船東事務所，這家船公司後來成為挪威較大的船運公司之一。
body.en: Mowinckel was born in Bergen on 22 October 1870 into an old Bergen merchant family. He bought his first ship in 1898 and in 1901 opened his own shipowning office in Bergen, which grew into one of Norway's larger shipping firms.

citations.quote: Fødd 22. oktober 1870, Bergen
Slekta Mowinckel høyrde til det gamle bergenske handelspatrisiatet
I 1898 kjøpte han det første skipet sitt
i 1901 oppretta han sitt eige reiarlagskontor i Bergen
Reiarlaget vart etter kvart eit av dei større i Norge

body.zh-Hant: 1898年他當選卑爾根市議會與市政委員會成員，1899年升任當地自由黨（Venstre）支部主席。1902年他接任市長，任到1906年，1911至1913年再度出任市長。
body.en: In 1898 he was elected to Bergen's city council and executive board, and in 1899 he became chairman of the local Venstre association. He took over as mayor in 1902 and held the post until 1906, and again from 1911 to 1913.

citations.quote: Alt i 1898 vart han vald inn i bystyre og formannskap
avanserte han i 1899 til leiarposisjonen i sjølve venstrelaget
i 1902 overtok han ordførarvervet
Det hadde han fram til 1906 og på nytt frå 1911 til 1913

heading.en: Member and president of the Storting

body.zh-Hant: 他代表卑爾根自由黨進入國會，任期為1906至1909年、1913至1918年，以及自1922年起至去世。1913至1915年他任下院議長，1916至1918年任國會議長，也在1916至1918年任自由黨議會黨團領袖；1917至1918年他任外交委員會主席。
body.en: He represented Bergen's Venstre in the Storting in 1906-1909, 1913-1918 and from 1922 until his death. He was president of the Odelsting in 1913-1915 and president of the Storting in 1916-1918, also leading the Venstre parliamentary group in 1916-1918, and chaired the foreign affairs committee in 1917-1918.

citations.quote: Bergens Venstre på Stortinget i åra 1906–1909, 1913–1918 og frå 1922
og frå 1922 og fram til sin død
I perioden 1913–1915 var Mowinckel odelstingspresident
i åra 1916–1918 stortingspresident
Venstres parlamentariske leiar i 1916–1918
formann i utanrikskomiteen i perioden 1917–1918

body.zh-Hant: 1921至1922年他任商業部長，1922至1923年任外交大臣。從1925年起他常任挪威出席國際聯盟的代表，1930年成為理事會成員，1933年出任日內瓦大會主席。
body.en: He was trade minister in 1921-1922 and foreign minister in 1922-1923. From 1925 he was a regular Norwegian delegate to the League of Nations, became a Council member in 1930 and president of the Assembly in Geneva in 1933.

citations.quote: I åra 1921–1922 var han handelsminister og i perioden 1922–1923 utanriksminister
Frå 1925 var Mowinckel stadig utsending til Folkeforbundet
Han vart rådsmedlem i 1930 og president i forsamlinga i Genève i 1933

body.zh-Hant: 他三度出任首相：1924年7月25日至1926年3月5日、1928年2月15日至1931年5月12日、1933年3月3日至1935年3月20日。資料寫明他任首相的那些年同時兼任外交大臣。1927年他接替古納爾·克努森出任自由黨黨魁，任到1943年去世。
body.en: He was prime minister three times: from 25 July 1924 to 5 March 1926, from 15 February 1928 to 12 May 1931 and from 3 March 1933 to 20 March 1935. The source says that in all his years as prime minister he was also foreign minister. In 1927 he succeeded Gunnar Knudsen as Venstre leader and held the post until he died in 1943.

citations.quote: frå 25. juli 1924 til 5. mars 1926
frå 15. februar 1928 til 12. mai 1931
frå 3. mars 1933 til 20. mars 1935
i alle sine år som statsminister var han også utanriksminister

body.zh-Hant: 1940年4月他是挪威流亡政府任命的三名顧問大臣之一，之後前往斯德哥爾摩。1942年5月他赴紐約，擔任船運總局顧問委員會主席，並退出內閣。他於1943年9月30日在紐約去世。
body.en: In April 1940 he was one of three consultative ministers appointed to the Norwegian government in exile and then went to Stockholm. In May 1942 he travelled to New York to chair the advisory committee of the shipping directorate, leaving the government. He died in New York on 30 September 1943.
